import hashlib
raw=open('SKILL.md','rb').read()
print('skill_sha256', hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
lines=raw.decode('utf-8').split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
print('lines', len(lines))
sec=lines[1805:1813]
while sec and sec[-1].strip()=='': sec.pop()
print('section_1806_1813_sha256', hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(sec).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest())
print('heading', repr(lines[1805]))
print('row_count', sum(1 for l in sec if l.startswith('| `')))
